definition: A 7B open model from a third family, used across 4 sources as the check that a result is not specific to the Llama and Qwen lines that dominate this archive. Its most consequential appearance is where the check fails in an informative direction: under three post-training algorithms on subjective judgement tasks, it improves on every task while a Qwen model falls below its own reasoning baseline on three of four under all three -- so the outcome is backbone-specific rather than algorithmic. It is also a subject in propositional-logic circuit analysis, in entropy-mechanism work, and in reproduction studies. Its 24B sibling appears in a cross-family steering audit with a significant positive effect.

evidence.note: Independently reproduces two published reliability methods and stress-tests them across models and domains their authors never tried, finding one reproduces exactly but loses significance everywhere new, and the other rests on a decodable logic direction that a same-norm random direction matches exactly under steering.
evidence.title: Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing

evidence.note: Uses elliptical bonuses over a language model's own hidden-state representations as a diversity signal, validates it in a clean inference-time selection setting, then transfers the same signal into RL post-training — where it eliminates the diversity collapse that degrades pass@k at large k.
evidence.title: Representation-Based Exploration for Language Models: From Test-Time to Post-Training

evidence.note: Establishes that RL trades policy entropy for reward along a predictable exponential curve R = -a·exp(H) + b, derives that entropy change is driven by the covariance between action probability and advantage, and controls it by restricting updates to the highest-covariance tokens.
evidence.title: The Entropy Mechanism of Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models

evidence.note: Uses causal mediation analysis on a minimal propositional logic task to recover a sparse reasoning circuit in Mistral-7B and Gemma-2 up to 27B, and decomposes it into four families of attention heads that execute rule locating, rule moving, fact processing and decision making as sequential steps.
evidence.title: A Implies B: Circuit Analysis in LLMs for Propositional Logical Reasoning

name: Mistral-7B
